resolvedFindings.summary: Terminal account-read failure permits explicit login/logout; an in-flight read still blocks new mutations. Unknown receipts and login identity protection remain.

method.inventory: All 233 rows freshly hashed and compared with frozen round2 and the round1 report; exactly two changed account files. Whole-source snapshot checked at entry and exit, 1991 files.
method.structure: Unchanged 231 files retain their exact-hash-bound round1 AST/import/declaration or non-code structure evidence. The two changed TSX files were freshly parsed using TypeScript 7 native API with zero syntactic diagnostics. No duplicated full type/test run.
method.semanticInheritance: The round1 full web review covers conversation loading/history/drafts, cross-provider model choices, subagent navigation, project/thread/terminal management, account/provider/MCP configuration, receipts/emergency recovery, execution identity, shared auth, workspace/process/files, automations, rendering and responsive layout. All unchanged behavior and test evidence is explicitly retained; this report does not claim all unchanged lines were freshly reread.
currentRecoveryReview: Rechecked useResource requestKey/generation behavior: stale data is hidden immediately on refresh; loading blocks login/logout, terminal error is settled without implying an unresolved mutation.

Rechecked AccountSettings accountReady versus accountSettled, authenticated-only limits, DOM and imperative mutation gates, owner/connection and global admission guards, receipt identity and original loginId recovery.

Rechecked failed-read login/logout assertions and the original-operation lookup path after a lost login response. No automatic authentication request, credential persistence or unknown-request replay was added.

Checked Settings/ProviderSettings account placement, stable runtime ownership and configurationReady admission. Account-error recovery does not bypass actual global unknown activity or management transactions.
Confirmed WEB001 closure against the exact root independent review and its 12/12 author test evidence; the repair author does not claim independent approval of their own two changed files.
method.overdesignAndDualSurface: The earlier desktop/mobile workflow review remains bound to unchanged model-picker, sidebar, execution settings and terminal surfaces. The account fix reuses existing shared buttons and an inline explanation, adding no duplicate settings or automatic login step. Prior local fixture screenshots remain visual evidence, not live acceptance.
method.evidenceAttribution: Root supplied independent changed-file review and coordinated official MCP freshness. The reviewer did not repeat successful targeted tests or the official network check.
